# `try_parse_json`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_parse_json(jsonStr)
```

Parse a JSON string as a Variant value. Return NULL when the string is not valid JSON value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_parse_json, example 1
> SELECT try_parse_json('{"a":1,"b":0.8}');
{"a":1,"b":0.8}
```

```sql
-- try_parse_json, example 2
> SELECT try_parse_json('{"a":1,');
NULL
```
